run_balance_sampling: run balance_sampling to probabilistically select entries based on their computed inclusion probabilities
run_main_pipeline: run the main balancing pipeline on a directory of JSON files with a frequency threshold
create_balanced_dataset: create a balanced curated dataset by sampling records inversely proportional to entry frequency
review_balance_sampling: review the balance_sampling function to understand its probabilistic selection logic for matched entry IDs
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support cross-JSON global deduplication and efficient numpy-based counting
